tasks.short: Note malfunctions and report actual conditions to the supervisor

tasks.short: Review and edit controlled operating procedures

outputs: Original source set with explicit versions, tag mapping and change scope

loop.purpose: Draft wording for an already selected technical edit without inventing operating instructions
loop.input: Actual chosen changes and original source excerpts

outputs: Stored exact final review revision, not an effective procedure

inputs: Exact stored final revision from s5
